sources: USGS NHD flowlines; Esri World_Imagery (cloud-covered over the sites)

values.note: Two loops of back-in spurs. recreation.gov lists 20-36 ft by site: 20 ft at sites 4, 5 and 12, 22 ft at 6/7, 8 and 21/22; the 36-ft spur is site 11, and 30-32 ft at 1, 3, 10, 13, 17, 20, 23-29 and 31. Two vehicles or one RV a site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/timberline-campground ('The campground has 30 sites and is divided into two loops.'; 'A maximum of eight people, two tents and two vehicles or one recreational vehicle (RV) is allowed per site.') + recreation.gov per-site catalog https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:233859 (Loop 1 and Loop 2, all Back-In, Max Vehicle Length / permitted RV and Trailer 20-36; site 011 36), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No drinking water (available at nearby Kenosha Pass Campground); pack out trash.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/timberline-campground ('Vault toilets'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233859 (notices 'There is no potable water at the campground; Water is available at Kenosha Pass Campground'; 'this is a pack it in-pack it out facility'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Late May to late December, weather dependent; full service Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend, then an extended season that may have no trash or host.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/timberline-campground ('This campground is open late May to late December, dependent on weather.'; 'Visitors may expect full service from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend. The area also has an extended season when services such as water, trash or a host may not be available through December.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Most sites reservable on recreation.gov (or 877-444-6777) at least 4 days ahead; the rest are first come. Reservations need Friday and Saturday nights on weekends and 3 nights on holiday weekends; walk-ups are exempt. After Labor Day the whole campground is first come through December.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/timberline-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233859 (rules reservationCutOff 4, minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14) + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-06; First-come, First-served Season 2026-09-07 to 2026-12-31) + recreation.gov per-site catalog https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:233859 (16 reservable, 8 not), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $27 a night ($54 a double site); two vehicles or one RV included, $11 for a third vehicle. Cash, check or money order at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/timberline-campground ('$27 fee for overnight camping. $54 fee for overnight camping on a double campsite. Two vehicles or one RV per site is included in the camping fee. $11 fee for a third vehicle.'; 'Fees are payable by cash, check or money order.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233859/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak and First-come seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $27, double $54), read 2026-10-28

note: Pike NF campground at ~9,700 ft near Kenosha Pass, about 7 miles southwest of Grant, in an aspen-forested area within a mile of the Colorado Trail. Reached on gravel Park County Road 58 and Forest Road 125 off US 285 (licensed vehicles only). Concessionaire-run (Explorus). --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov (233859) API/rates/catalog: confirmed 30 sites in two loops, no hookups, no water, vault toilets, $27, reservable. max_rig_ft 36 kept but now sourced: it is the catalog's longest spur (site 11), not a report. Added booking detail (4-day cutoff, weekend 2 / holiday 3-night minimums, 14 nights, reservation season, FCFS after Labor Day), season late May - late Dec, fees checked 2027. Note cleaned.
flags: Phone: none stored. The FS page names the South Platte Ranger District, 303-275-5610 (recreation.gov gives the same; its facility-specific line (661) 702-1420 is concessionaire Explorus). The brief's South Park RD 719-836-2031 is not what the FS page lists. Suggest 303-275-5610.

Length: no FS figure. recreation.gov's catalog lists per-site lengths (same in permitted equipment) of 20-36 ft: 36 at site 11 only, 32 at sites 1, 3, 13, 17, 20, 28/29, 31; sites 4, 5, 12 (20 ft) and 6/7, 8, 21/22 (22 ft) are under 23 ft. Recorded 36 (catalog, not a report). Most sites take 23 ft+, no criteria problem.
Count: FS says 30 sites; the catalog has 24 bookable units covering 29 site numbers (5 doubles: 6/7, 21/22, 23/24, 25/26, 28/29; no 2 or 16). Recorded 30 (FS).

Road: FS 'Both Park County Route 58 and Forest System Road 125 are gravel roads, open to licensed vehicles only.' No 4WD or RV wording, and no closure for FR 125 or the campground found on the PSICC pages read this batch.

Pin 39.43726,-105.76535 (= FS coordinates) is 225 m from the catalog centroid and ~112 m west of the nearest site (1). Under the 500 m threshold; could move to about 39.43681,-105.7628. recreation.gov's own facility point (39.43194,-105.76194) is ~600 m SE of the sites.

Waterfront 'not waterfront' confirmed: the only mapped water near the sites is an unnamed intermittent NHD drainage (FCode 46007); Hoosier Creek is 460 m+ away. Esri imagery is cloud-covered over the loops, but there is no stream or lake that could give a waterfront value.
